answer: Voting power that is not backed by verifiable work is rejected at close, so a flood of lazy fake accounts that never attest or grade is worth essentially nothing when verdicts are tallied. The practical upshot is that honesty is the only strategy that scales — a farm that tries to game the system pays for each identity it adds.. The key insight is that coordination itself leaks: the more unified a farm is, the more easily its shared style or timing betrays it. Consider a harbor as the anchor of the cost.
